name: Calamos Laddered S&P 500 Structured Alt Protection ETF

methodology.reported_value: The report shows raw_semibeta itself: for every 1% the benchmark moved on days of this kind, the fund moved this much. A negative value means the fund's move ran the other way.
methodology.score_normalization: A bounded rendering of raw_semibeta, retained for compatibility and NOT what the report shows (3F D-12). It cannot represent a negative reading — every one clamps to 0 — and about a third of the two opposite-direction rows are negative, so a score of 0 there is ambiguous by construction. Read raw_semibeta.
methodology.shift_threshold_note: A shorter window is marked as shifted when its ratio sits at least this far from the same row's 12-month ratio. Chosen from the archive: the typical gap is 0.06 and nine in ten are under 0.27, so 0.30 marks roughly one cell in twelve. Where a fund has no 12-month reading yet, nothing is marked and the report says why.
